observations: All four views use the selected B identity. A/C remain historical static appearances.
Hare bounds, squirrel scampers, cat extends and gathers its spine, bear uses heavy shoulder-led motion, and hoofed animals have separate strides.
Birds have folded-wing ground movement and articulated flight. Chicken flight is a short one-shot flutter.
Frog jump includes crouch, takeoff, extension, descent and landing. Frog, fish and duck have swimming cycles.
All six requested attackers have dedicated one-shot attacks in four directions.
Wild-boar walking source was regenerated to separate touching silhouettes; source-normalization metadata preserves its physical export scale.
Transparent exports and packed atlas frames were checked for clipping, missing images and exact pixel correspondence.
scope: Visual asset pack and playback configurations. Game-engine integration, world movement, AI, collision and damage are not implemented.
